domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: 25 named cortical units per hemisphere (24 gyri/lobules plus insula); lobe views must be derived by metadata aggregation. Missing separate paracentral lobule, transverse temporal gyri and inferior-frontal subdivisions.
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Six cortical units per hemisphere (five lobes plus insula), useful for orientation but too coarse for gyral teaching/localisation.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: Basal ganglia cores plus 12 paired Hypothalamic/preoptic/periventricular nuclei, geniculate bodies, colliculi, habenula and pineal body. Missing claustrum, nucleus accumbens, thalamic nuclear subdivisions and basal-forebrain nuclei.
domain_scores.domain: Deep gray matter, diencephalon and Hypothalamus
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Strong basal-ganglia set and uniquely includes claustrum and nucleus accumbens, but almost no Hypothalamic nuclear detail.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: Pons, medulla, cerebral crura, colliculi, red nuclei and substantia nigra are separate; cerebellum remains one gross mesh. Missing nearly all cranial-nerve/reticular/tegmental nuclei, inferior olive, cerebellar lobes/vermis/hemispheres, deep cerebellar nuclei and peduncles.
domain_scores.spike_rationale: One gross brainstem and cerebellum, but uniquely includes inferior olives and deep cerebellar nuclei.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: Lateral/third/fourth ventricles, aqueduct, interventricular foramen, bilateral choroid plexus and central canal are selectable.
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Same ventricular core except no separate central canal.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: Corpus callosum, anterior/posterior commissures, fornices, internal capsules, striae, mammillothalamic tracts and collicular brachia. No named long association bundles, corona radiata subdivisions, optic/auditory radiations, lemnisci or spinal tracts; temporal white-matter labels are geometrically suspect and hidden.
domain_scores.domain: White matter, commissures and named internal pathways
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Core commissures/fornices/internal capsules and septum pellucidum, but fewer small named bundles and the same absence of tract-level pathway geometry.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: All 12 nerves are present bilaterally at proximal/main-trunk level, plus optic/olfactory tracts and trigeminal divisions. Distal vagal geometry needs adjudication and remains hidden.
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Most main nerves plus distal trigeminal branches; no explicit vestibulocochlear/cochlear/vestibular nerve and no olfactory tract in the inventory.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: Whole cord, cauda equina and central canal only. No cord levels/segments, gray-matter horns/columns, white-matter funiculi/tracts, rootlets or spinal meninges as selectable CNS anatomy.
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Whole cord and cauda equina only within the app-default CNS set; roots/ganglia exist elsewhere in the full spike but are peripheral/spinal-nerve context rather than internal cord anatomy.

domain_scores.bp3d_rationale: Falx cerebri, a whole-brain dural shell (hidden by default), pituitary and pineal context; only the right half of tentorium cerebelli exists in the selected source set.
domain_scores.spike_rationale: Falx and a tentorium concept are present, but no pineal/pituitary context in the spike inventory.

method.score_scale: 0–5 per weighted teaching domain, normalised to 100
method.spike_comparison_set: Sprint 1 app-default categories: axis, cortex, cranial, deep, meninges, ventricles, white
